---
title: "Submit Your Software"
toc: false
---

The CERTH OSPO maintains a catalogue of open-source software projects developed at CERTH. If you
have a project you would like to include, submit it using the form below. Submissions are manually
reviewed by the OSPO team before being added to the catalogue.

## How It Works

1. **Fill in the form**: provide basic information about your project.
2. **Manual review**: the OSPO team reviews the submission to verify it meets the minimum
   requirements for open-source publication.
3. **Catalogue integration**: approved projects are added to the CERTH software catalogue.
